domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由基础沉降等外部几何变化传递形成的钢轨变形。
usage_overview: 在利用车辆响应研究路基沉降影响时，钢轨附加变形作为沉降传递至钢轨后的附加几何激励，用于分析沉降对车辆—轨道系统的影响，并研究路基沉降阈值。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P083.title: Study on the long-distance settlement threshold of high-speed railway subgrade based on vehicle responses
P083.authors: Z Li, W Wang, L Xu, J Xu
P083.label: Li等（2024）

complete_examples.text: The simulation results show that the low-frequency vibrations of vehicle are mainly excited by the additional deformation of rails induced by settlement.
Based on the correlation between the vehicle responses and the second derivative of additional deformation of rails, the threshold of long-distance settlement can be determined.
